changes.line: TL;DR: The big one is here. A new home and lobby experience, Agent Mastery system, Gauntlet: Glitched, Practice Range in Queue, The Warden, Competitive Updates, and more are ALL LAUNCHING TODAY!
If you’ve earned a bunch of new content in recent matches but haven’t yet seen it, you’ll now see indicators in your Collection signifying what’s new to you.
Send out Raze’s Boom Bot and decide when it goes boom. Clock it.
Make Gekko’s Wingman really, really big. They grow up so fast.

Agent Mastery gives you new ways to show your dedication to an Agent. When you play Clove, you progress Clove. When you play Sova, you progress Sova. Every Agent has their own Act levels, Lifetime levels, Reward Track, and Agent ID.

Introducing the latest automatic Rifle to join the Vandal and Phantom in the 2900 credits tier— the Warden. Built to offer a new tactical choice, the Warden brings a distinct long-range option to your arsenal.

Fixed an issue where Agents with possessable abilities (Tejo, Sova, Gekko, Cypher, Skye) were not being flashed when they exited a possessable ability at the exact same time an enemy activated a flash.
Fixed an issue with Cypher Trapwire where the trap would look active after Cypher was killed or suppressed at the exact moment the trap was reactivating.
